predefined_thresholds.strong_one_to_one: ARI >= 0.70 and max conditional prob >= 0.75 reciprocally
predefined_thresholds.many_to_one_collapse: Multiple independent clusters collapse predominantly (>= 0.70) into single combined cluster

interpretative_summary: Independent post-monsoon M24 clustering partitions the post-monsoon domain into fine gradations of convective/cirrus scenes (Clusters 0, 1, 2 = 17.0% total) against a massive background of fair-weather scenes (Cluster 3 = 83.0%). In contrast, the common three-season M25 model maps 79.5% to 89.1% of M24 Clusters 0, 1, 2 into Combined Regime 3 (thin cirrus & anvil debris), while partitioning M24 Cluster 3 across Combined Regimes 3 (63.4%), 1 (22.7%), and 0 (12.7%). This produces near-zero global agreement (ARI = -0.0576, NMI = 0.0422).
